question: Can stable episode-local sensory content become incrementally useful when a causal PFC-conditioned adapter translates the retrieval into a prediction correction?

frozen_components: neural place code and conjunctive address

diagnostic_basis.conclusion: Residual content is nonstationary and compressed poorly; stable sensory content exists, but fixed linear addition has less than one percent ceiling.

causal_inputs: PFC hidden computed from action and previous sensory history
HPC retrieval read before the current write

registered_evaluation.status_at_freeze: not used by the content-path diagnosis or adapter design

acceptance_gates: zero-retrieval and memory_scale-zero endpoints exactly equal PFC-only
strict observed-only adapter MSE beats its paired PFC-only endpoint by at least 1% relative
paired-bootstrap 90% lower bound of PFC-only minus adapter error is above zero
future ground-truth reads and writes are zero
future observation perturbation max delta is zero

decision_rule.advance: Only if every acceptance gate passes; then train a second seed and extend the rollout horizon.
decision_rule.stop: If the paired one-percent gate fails, stop fusion tuning and redesign the stored neural content representation.
